headline: Common questions
subheadline: The things people ask before we start. If yours isn't here, just write to me.

items.a: Because the site is yours — code, domain and hosting in your name, not a rental on someone else's platform. And it's built around your offer: faster and cleaner on Google than a ready-made theme.
The price is fixed in writing before we start. It depends on scope — a landing page, a site, or a shop. Write to me, we clarify what you need, and you get a number before work, not after.

items.q: What if I don't like the design?
items.a: You see the design before I write code. We revise it there. After launch you have 30 days of free revisions.

items.q: Who owns the site if we stop working together?
items.a: You do. Domain, hosting and the repository are in your name. If we stop working, the site stays with you.
